features:
- [KERNEL / SCRCPY] Surface lock 230x480px, triệt tiêu letterbox rasterization, tối ưu H.264 pipeline stream.
- [INPUT IPC] 3-Zone Anchor normalization (Top/Body/Bottom) bù trừ aspect ratio 16:9 vs 20:9 qua socket ADB event tap/swipe.
- [UI ENGINE] Dynamic viewport reflow breakpoint <880px (56px icon) & <680px, tối ưu GDI+ double-buffered pump.
- [ROUTING / SEC] Cô lập routing layer CC/BIN auth module phục vụ upgrade cryptographic handshake.
- [SYS PROPS / KERNEL] Triệt tiêu prop leakage 9-partition & sandbox SQLite accounts_ce.db isolated uid.
